correctness.rationale: For any nondegenerate symmetric bilinear g including characteristic two, selfadjoint A with image in U factors V→V/U-perp≅U*→U, second map symmetric; full-image maps form open nonsingular Sym²(U) locus. AB=0 with both selfadjoint is exactly orthogonality of images U=imA and W=imB, giving ranks s+t<=n; the incidence base Gr(t,U-perp) over Gr(s,V) is smooth geometrically irreducible, with affine symmetric-tensor bundle. Dimension reduces to D_n(s+t)=(s+t)(2n-s-t+1)/2. Proper incidence with allowed ranks proves C_i closed irreducible, equidimensional, and any intersection determined by min/max indices, generically rank (i,n-j); no statement on scheme-theoretic reducedness. For finite fields choose U/W by Gaussian binomials and nonsingular symmetric tensors S_s,S_t, valid for q even and odd; summing gives Z_n(q), leading (n+1)q^{n(n+1)/2} at fixed n. Independent complete F2 matrix enumeration n=2 and n=3 verifies total 18 and 204 and all rank fibers. These finite tests are limited; the all-field statements follow from incidence geometry and symmetric-matrix counts.

originality.rationale: Targeted Resultary and literature comparisons show no earlier exact all-rank and all-component intersection classification for pairs of g-selfadjoint operators with only AB=0 and no square-zero restriction. Earlier full theorems on mutually annihilating selfadjoint tuples require EACH X_i²=0, inducing totally isotropic common image and Witt-dependent counts; they do not imply arbitrary zero-product pairs, which include (I,0). Unrestricted matrix zero-product and nilpotent-pair results likewise omit fixed selfadjoint constraints. Basili 2000 commuting rank-variety abstract is related but does not state product-zero stratification; full article inaccessible and remains specific residual risk. Originality assessed best-of-knowledge.
